source: PRD v1.1 R-14 and ADR-007 Decision 3 (internal spec). Patterns written by the intake developer agent 2026-11-07; not taken from an external catalogue.
source_note: Deterministic suspicious-content patterns narrowed to system-style prompt injection. HIGH = role markers, chat-template tokens, override phrases (R-14); hidden text and zero-width characters are HIGH via R-03 findings, not via this table. LOW = tool / JSON-call syntax. Plain consumer imperatives ('please delete this late payment') must NOT match. False-positive rate on real consumer letters is unknown (U23); measured only on synthetic clean fixtures. Regexes are Python `re` syntax, matched case-insensitively against text that has been NFKC-normalised, had zero-width characters removed and (for file names) '_', '-' and '.' replaced by spaces.

entries.description: Chat role marker such as 'SYSTEM:' or 'assistant:' at a line start or after whitespace/punctuation
Model chat-template control tokens (role markers in template form)

Instruction-override phrase with a qualifier (all/previous/prior/above/...), e.g. 'ignore previous instructions', 'ignore all instructions', 'disregard the above rules'. 'disregard the rules' alone does not match.
Attempt to install new instructions or reference the system prompt
